owner_request: 这个逻辑加上呗，可以吗（引用净浮盈2R后下一根含费保本）
selection_basis: Explicit owner choice after reviewing existing results; not development selection or proof of improvement.
trigger_observation: Surviving closed-bar high for long / low for short: gross favorable R minus fixed round-trip cost R >= 2.
activation: Install at that close; effective next bar. Current bar retains prior stop priority.
rounding: Round long cost stop upward and short downward to tick.
ratchet: Take tighter of old protection, cost stop and original close-based 4ATR trailing stop; never loosen.
initial_stop: Frozen 5-bar extrema with 0.2ATR buffer and 2ATR price-risk floor.
original_trail_arm: Closed gross R >= 2; distinct from net favorable excursion protection trigger.
reverse_exit: Raw opposite V6 at next open, including outside admitted ICT hours.
entry: Existing V8 admission at next open within New York [02:00,11:00), weekends included.
